title: Rosalind and the Cipher
author: Elodie Ishikawa
blurb: Oscar Voss, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the tide gives up what it took.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
